lines: Could you bend reality with your will?
Every choice you make takes you into a reality that would not exist, if you hadn't chosen it.
Right now, you can keep scrolling.
Or you can put your phone down, and read about how planes fly.
Did that small choice change reality?
In one version, you scroll a little longer, and fall asleep.
But because of the choice you made, reality split.
And now there's a world where you know how planes fly.
So if one small choice can change reality,
Imagine a future where your business is thriving,
and you're living the life you always dreamed of.
Could you steer reality toward that version, with the choices you make, and the actions you take?
and we'll show you how to bend reality toward the life you want.
